notes.title: Massive Update Information
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Wanted to keep you all updated; I am still hard at work on the next update, and its going to be a MASSIVE one!

I am very busy in my private life but I am working on additions/changes and fixes when I have time, and I am quite happy with how the update is coming along.

A few changes that are coming in the update are, story changes, location changes, location additions, new "interest points", more alien interactions, more "scares", day/night cycle changes and many other things that I hope you all look forward to!

I will keep you all updated as to when I have a planned release date for this update, but for now I am not sure when it will be ready due to personal commitments.

Thank you all, I hope you are all excited!

notes.title: Player Input Needed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

So I'll get straight to it, obviously the reception from Unknown Presence hasn't been the best, so I am here to ask you, the players, what exactly did you like and not like about the game?
If I am to improve on the game even more than I already have I need to know what went good and what went wrong.

Please write down anything you would like to let me know in the comments below!

Thank you all very much

notes.title: Update V1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Got a large update for you all today, here's whats changed!

Additions/Changes:

[list]
[*] Added a new item; Running Shoes! They will make you run a bit faster.
[*] Added a new menu; The Inventory. This menu will be used to view your key items and to look at your already discovered notes/drawings at all times.
[*] Added the aliens eggs to the map when using alien vision.
[*] Added a new drawing.
[*] Have changed the maps orientation to better reflect the compass.
[*] Have adjusted some incorrect colliders.
[*] Have adjusted the automatic graphical selection to be lower.
[*] Have changed it so that after you break 1 alien egg the time will set to night time and will not change after.
[*] Have adjusted how the alien eggs spawn.
[*] Have changed some of the aliens movement animations.
[*] Have adjusted the footstep sounds.
[*] Have made it so med kits make a sound when your health is full instead of a text popup.
[*] Have adjusted location discovery area so it better matches where the location is.
[*] Have done further optimisations to the world.
[/list]


Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the rain to not turn back on after leaving an indoor location.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the incorrect objective to be added after getting the alien weapon.
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the eggs broken amount to skip a count.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the tomb door to be opened before placing the cube.
[*] Fixed a few issues with select achievements.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the text to overlap after you charge the cube.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the cave audio to continue to play even after leaving the cave if it is nighttime.
[*] Fixed various triggers.
[/list]


Thank you all,
Hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Small Update 1.2b
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just a small update today to fix an issue that's been brought to my attention. There are a few other things in this update that were coming out in the bigger update this week, so you'll get a little bonus early.


[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the cave wooden barrier colliders to stay active even after breaking the wall down.
[*] Have done further texture optimisations.
[*] Have adjusted the tree and rock density slightly, to help with performance.
[*] Have added all new rocks and content into the underground cave system (this is part of the big update, so it's not 100% done right now)
[/list]


Thank you!

notes.title: Small Update V1.2a
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just a small update today that fixes some issues caused by the last update/other issues and also adjusts a few things:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the gas mask tutorial overlay to stay active when looking at other tutorials.
[*] Fixed an issue with the axe breakable walls not being able to be re-broken when you load a save.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the compass not to update position after loading save.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player to be able to walk/run at full speed while crouching.
[*] Fixed an issue with the death sequence not healing the player properly.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing an aliens animation to loop.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain aliens not to navigate properly.
[*] Have done further optimisation of textures in the game to help with performance.
[*] Have adjusted the player walk/run speed to be a bit faster so you can navigate quicker.
[/list]

Thank you all,
I will be doing another larger update sometime this week, so look forward to that!

notes.title: Unknown Presence Update V1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've got a nice juicy update for you all today! Have a look at what's changed in version 1.2!

[b]Additions/Changes:
[/b][list]
[*] The health system has been completely overhauled.
[*] You can now see your health.
[*] You can now use first aid kits to heal yourself.
[*] Added a faint light to some interactable items to make them more obvious.
[*] Added a new item; the gas mask!
[*] Added new interactable drawings around the map to give you more guidance on the location of items and also for more interest.(More to come in the future)
[*] Added the controls popups to the starting sequence of the main scene.
[*] Added inverted X and Y options in the menu.
[*] Added some missing controls to the controls menu.
[*] Added a disclaimer in the controls menu.
[*] Adjusted some of the controls.
[*] Alien eggs now produce a poisonous gas that will damage you (Use gas mask)
[*] Completely overhauled the first starting scene, to make it into a short animation instead of a playable area.
[*] Have made it so that if you do not pick up the map item in the starting sequence it will automatically be given to you.
[*] Changed the way the injury system works, so now you will only be injured when your health is low enough.
[*] Changed the day night cycle times, so now the cycle is shorter in general but also now the night time is longer than the day.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:
[/b][list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player to stay injured if you opened the pause menu while injured.
[*] Fixed an issue causing one of the alien spawns to not behave correctly when triggered.
[*] Fixed various animations not playing correctly.
[*] Fixed other various bugs.
[/list]

Please let me know what you think of this update and any suggestions you have. 

Thank you,

notes.title: Unknown Presence Update V1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've got the first update here for you all today! I've done many fixes and have added some things. Please read below for all changes.

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added extra text to indicate when you cannot go through a door.
[*] Added and adjusted some story related particle effects.
[*] Added music for when you're close to an alien.
[*] Added extra sounds for alien vision and other various events.
[*] Added a new alien that spawns earlier than previously implemented.
[*] Added extra objects around the map.
[*] Added a couple new post processing effects in certain areas.
[/list]

[b]Fixes/adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Have done extra optimisations in the first house scene.
[*] Have fixed an issue allowing the player to walk on water.
[*] Have fixed a couple grammatical errors in the game notes.
[*] Have fixed a few UI issues.
[*] Have fixed an issue causing ambient animal noises to still play when underground.
[*] Have fixed/adjusted various animations.
[*] Have fixed an issue that caused the death animation to be skipped in the last second.
[*] Have fixed an issue that caused some aliens to not have footstep sounds.
[*] Have fixed an issue causing certain items in interiors not to render.
[*] Have adjusted most of the aliens detection radius's to make it harder for you to be detected.
[/list]


Thank you all for your support so far! Please let me know any issues you encounter so that I can fix them! :)

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

I am happy to say that Unknown Presence is now released! I really hope you all enjoy the game and please let me know what you think about the game in the reviews and discussions when you play it!

[b]FOR DEMO PLAYERS: Please delete your save before playing the main game, the demo save will transfer over but many many things have been added since the demo so it will most likely cause bugs.[/b]

Thank you very much,
Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've got a new demo update out for you all. The patch notes are as below.

[list]
[*] Have changed the location of the clothes in the start sequence to be more obvious
[*] Have added a subtle flashing animation to the Clothes location, the bag and the mailbox in the starting sequence to make it more obvious where to go.
[*] Have done further optimisations in the starting sequence area to help with frame rate issues.
[*] Have added more lighting and signs to help the player find the correct direction to go in the start of the main forest scene.
[*] Have added a small icon that indicates when the game is saving.
[*] Have added some more ambient sounds in the forest scene.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some text to not translate.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the orbs to still create sound even when de-spawned.
[*] Fixed various issues with certain doors having incorrect sound and or moving too slow.
[*] Fixed some lighting issues.
[*] Have made it so that if you're in a note and you press ESC to exit the pause menu no longer opens.
[*] Have done some further optimisations in the main forest scene(more to come in the future)
[*] And lastly have done various fixes and optimisations throughout all scenes.
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and patience, please keep informing me of issues and I will continue to fix them asap! :)

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I have just released a small update for the Unknown Presence demo, below are the changes.


[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain texts would get stuck on your screen when triggered.
[*] Fixed an issue where the ending of the demo wouldn't properly trigger.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing some notes in the game to have the incorrect UI.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing objects that spawn at night to spawn during the day.
[*] Fixed and issue where some of the cinematic cameras would loop their animations.
[*] Fixed multiple sounds in the game that were glitching/being called when they weren't supposed to be.
[*] Altered the crouch script so that when you un-crouch you don't pop up so high.
[/list]

I would also like to mention that I am still working on optimising the house scene at the start of the game, as of right now it appears to be the shadows that is causing the low fps, so if you wish you can turn the shadows down in the mean time to help fix that.
Please submit any and all bugs you encounter to me so that I know what I need to fix!

Thank you,
Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Developer Log 3
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,
[/b]In this dev log I have a bit of lore for the games area and some nice screenshots of one of the important locations in the game. 

[b]Introduction to the Ogistok National Forest
[/b]
Ogistok meaning sky in the local native language. There is a story told for generations that the name comes from when their God came down from the sky and gave them knowledge to better their lives.
Here is the cabin experience, people come from far and wide to hire one of the 8 cabins they have available. Many people come to try and get a glimpse of the Gods that the native people talk
about, but we have not seen any evidence for this so far.

Here are some new screenshots of the area! I will be posting more about game mechanics etc soon, for now though I am wanting to show areas in the game off! :)

I've got a few new screenshots to show you all.

notes.title: The Store Page Is Here!!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Unknown Presence is a first-person adventure horror game where you will witness unexplainable phenomena, from floating orbs to unknown beings. You will explore many locations, from caves all the way up to snowy mountains and everything in between.

We hope you're excited to see more about the game! We will publish some more trailers in the coming weeks/months to show more of the games mechanics and environment off, if you have any suggestions please put them below!

[b]Thank you all! :)[/b]
